_doc: mcp_agent_mail — multi-agent coordination: session identity, file reservations, messaging. Upstream Dicklesworthstone/mcp_agent_mail, typically run as a long-lived local service (e.g. a systemd user unit) against its own storage root. HTTP, not stdio: upstream allows ONE server per storage root, so an in-process stdio client cannot coexist with the service. Local sessions hit 127.0.0.1 and pass through the server's localhost bypass; a remote client on another machine adds `headers.Authorization: Bearer <token>` in ITS machine-local copy; keep the token in a secret store (never checked into this public repo).
